capabilities: Ask questions about the active note with context reused across follow-ups
Query across the whole vault in whole-vault mode
Save conversations as Markdown notes in a Codex chats folder
Configure the Codex model and reasoning effort
Locate and connect to the Codex executable automatically or by explicit path
extras: Part of the README is written in Chinese. Explicitly does not use or store an OpenAI API key; it relies on ChatGPT-plan Codex usage. Sessions are read-only (no file edits or shell approvals). Includes connection troubleshooting (codex --version, codex login, proxy settings, macOS executable path). Warns maintainers not to distribute data.json because it contains machine-specific paths.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ask AI questions grounded in the current note or across vault files.

relations.evidence: ask questions about the current note or the entire vault through your locally installed OpenAI Codex CLI

summary: Chat sidebar that answers questions about the active note or whole vault through a locally installed OpenAI Codex CLI.
